simple.meaning: Gudgodah , a place in the Desert
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֻּדְגֹּדָה (H1412) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.

simple.summary: גֻּדְגֹּדָה (Gudgôdâh) means Gudgodah , a place in the Desert First listed occurrence: Deut 10 7.

definitions.short: Gudgodah , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H1412. Gudgodah גֻּדְגֹּ֫דָה with article הַגֻּדְגֹּ֫דָה proper name, of a location (meaning dubious) station of Israel in wilderness Deut 10:7 (twice in verse) (in || Num 33:32 הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד חֹר see below חֹר ).
